text:
maria: FYI I hit a weird Deno/Bun onboarding problem while trying the JS SDK quickstart with Deno 1.35.0. import fails with `Cannot resolve module` and types are unhappy.
kevin: ugh, can you paste the exact import you used and the error?
maria: using the example from README: `import Redwood from 'redwood';` in Deno it errors. stack: `Error: package.json exports do not contain ./deno` and TS error about default export.
maria: repro steps: 1) deno run --allow-net example.ts 2) example.ts: `import Redwood from 'redwood'; const c = new Redwood();`
maria: also `crypto.subtle` is undefined in some Bun versions, so auth signing fails intermittently.
kevin: right — Deno wants explicit ESM entrypoints or a deno-specific entry. For Bun we've seen differences in cjs/esm interop.
sam: we should provide a deno-friendly entry and a Bun note. Proposed quick fixes: add `deno/deno.ts` export entry, publish ESM-only build with named exports, and add a tiny polyfill for `crypto.subtle` fallback in the auth helper.
kevin: Agree on deno entry. Example package.json conditional exports snippet I usually use: ```json
{
  "exports": {
    "./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs",
    "./browser": "./dist/web/index.mjs",
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
    }
  }
}
```
kevin: then README can show: `import Redwood from 'redwood/deno'` or `import { Redwood } from 'redwood'` depending on runtime.
nina: for typings, Deno needs a types entry pointing to a d.ts that uses ESM declarations — we should publish `dist/deno/index.d.ts` and set `types` in package.json or export types from the deno entry.
maria: also ran into fetch differences: Bun returns a ReadableStream for response.body in a way that breaks our body parsing util. Quick patch: normalize to `await response.arrayBuffer()` fallback.
sam: good call. We should centralize a tiny runtime-adapters module: runtimeIs: { isDeno, isBun, isNode } and small polyfills used only when needed. Keep tree shakeable.
kevin: CI-wise we should add a nightly matrix job: node 18/20, deno x.y, bun x.y running the sample-apps. ci-bot: nightly deno test failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 (logs show `import` resolve error).
nina: is someone volunteering to own docs + one-line code change? this is blocking a partner POC.
maria: I can PR the README and a quick `deno` entrypoint. will open PR today, add test.
sam: I'll take the auth polyfill and runtime-adapters refactor.
kevin: can you both add changelog note and call out compatibility in release notes? partner will need exact versions that work.
maria: thanks — adding a minimal example to `examples/deno-quickstart` with import map and `deno.json` config. Example import in README will be: ```ts
import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') });
```
kevin: :thumbsup: That should make onboarding much smoother.
ci-bot: created issue #428: "Deno/Bun SDK compatibility — deno entrypoint, runtime adapters, polyfills" assigned to maria,sam.
maria: I'll link the PR here when ready. thanks all — want to avoid `node-only` examples sneaking into quickstarts again. :slightly_smiling_face:
